description: This file implements the basic functions for the Slap Loam Client Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It includes functions to create, remove, enroll objects, and initialize the object, managing internal components like timers and interfaces. The file defines the structure and behavior of the SlapLco (Loam Client Object) including object lifecycle management and internal setup procedures.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapLcoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new SLAP Loam Client Object, setting up its core structural members and returning the handle to the created object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLcoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the specified SLAP Loam Client Object, freeing associated resources and memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLcoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls required internal components such as timers and interfaces necessary for the object's operation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLcoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the SLAP Loam Client Object, setting default property values and function pointers.
